establishedFacts: The Grenada Tourism Authority lists Hangers as a planner of weddings and celebratory events and publishes its organizational email and phone.
Hangers’ official About page identifies Khaleen Johnson as founder and principal event planner.
Its destination package specifically offers guest-accommodation/group-rate assistance, guest transportation management and related social-event assistance.
Its full package advertises venue selection recommendations, vendor hiring/management, contract review and final-payment handling.
The homepage self-reports 100+ wedding events, 200+ decorated events and 300+ global clients; these are undated marketing totals, not independently audited production or hotel bookings.
The official resort wedding page states accommodation for up to 35 event guests and advertises full-service event staff, custom packages and catering.
The 2025 Radisson event listings demonstrate historical hotel-event use, not future demand at Spice Island.
uncertainties: No future programme date, contracted banquet, lodging requirement, room-night volume, budget or existing Spice Island relationship was verified.
No individual’s authority to contract hotel accommodation on behalf of a couple was explicitly established.
Aviann Murray’s profile associates her with Hangers as Administrative/Event Coordinator, but current tenure and accommodation responsibilities are unresolved.
Crystal Charles, Kristina Morgan and Kazzara Baptiste have historical Hangers experience; their present ability or willingness to refer business is unverified.

Chinelle and Krystel are identified by first name in customer reviews; surnames, current roles and direct professional channels are unverified. They must not be conflated with similarly named profiles.
Current external-planner rules, referral economics, non-resident access charges, banquet inclusions, accessibility and availability require direct resort confirmation.
qualificationQuestions: Which future weddings or private celebrations still need a venue or guest accommodation, and what are the event and arrival/departure dates?
How many ceremony/reception attendees and overnight guests are expected, with what suite mix, stay lengths and accessibility needs?
Does the party fit the resort’s advertised up-to-35-guest wedding offering, and what is the seated-reception/weather-backup capacity for its layout?
Does Hangers recommend hotels only, negotiate group rates, collect payments, or sign accommodation contracts on a client’s behalf? Who approves spend and signs each agreement?
Will guests book/pay individually, use a courtesy block, or have a master-billed arrangement?
Is Spice Island an approved venue, and may Hangers coordinate/design on site alongside the resort’s planners?
Which welcome parties, rehearsal dinners, receptions or other events are needed, and which food/beverage elements are outside the all-inclusive rate?
What budget range, referral/commission terms, deposits, attrition/cancellation terms, vendor rules and non-resident access conditions apply?
snapshot.recommendedNextStep: Send a concise B2B partnership enquiry addressed to Khaleen Johnson via the published organizational inbox info@hangersgrenada.com or telephone 473.458.6043. Explain that Spice Island is exploring intimate luxury wedding/accommodation referrals and ask for a short venue visit and discussion of unplaced future celebrations. Do not imply an existing booking or solicit past couples directly. Ask Khaleen to identify the current accommodation coordinator, client approver and contract signatory. In parallel, use reservations@spicebeachresort.com or the resort wedding enquiry form to confirm capacity, outside-planner rules and a named on-property wedding/group contact. Debbie Cleary is an optional hotel-side sales referral, particularly for UK-market business, not the planner’s buyer. Only prepare an event-specific proposal after dates, headcount, stay requirements, budget fit and authority are qualified.
